entries.name: South of Deepwood Shrine
entries.area: In front of Deepwood Shrine
entries.howTo: Lying on the ground just south of the Deepwood Shrine entrance; from the stump where Ezlo teaches you to shrink, go left, up and left again. Available as soon as you reach the woods.

entries.name: Past Syrup the Witch's Hut
entries.area: Path southwest of Syrup the Witch's Hut
entries.howTo: Once the Witch's Hut part of the woods opens (after first visiting Castor Wilds and seeing Rem fall asleep), follow the path from Syrup the Witch's Hut to its southwest end, by a pool of water. It can also be reached by swimming up from the southern part of the woods.
entries.note: Guides differ on the way in: the Cane of Pacci, swimming up with the Flippers, or the Spare Key from the north. You'll have the Cane of Pacci by the time this part of the woods opens.

entries.name: Leftmost of three Minish caves
entries.area: Minish-sized cave (ice path), west of Minish Village
entries.howTo: Shrink at the stump just west of Minish Village, swim across the water and cross the bridge to the left, then go up to three Minish-sized tunnels; take the leftmost and follow the icy path to the end.

entries.name: Northeast pier
entries.area: End of the wooden walkway, northeast corner
entries.howTo: In Minish Village, go to the northeast corner by the blue-roofed house and follow the wooden walkway or pier at the top right to its end.

entries.name: Behind the web in the Gust Jar room
entries.area: Room where the Madderpillar is fought / Gust Jar found
entries.howTo: After beating the Madderpillar and getting the Gust Jar, suck the web off the doorway at the bottom right (east side of the south wall) and go through to the secret room.
entries.note: The whole dungeon is explored at Minish size.

entries.name: Blue portal ledge
entries.area: Room north of the big barrel room
entries.howTo: In the room north of the barrel room, use the Gust Jar on the dust piles to uncover two switches; stepping on them reveals the blue portal. After getting the Big Key and revealing the red portal, take the red portal and then the blue one to reach the ledge with the piece.

entries.name: Big Green ChuChu
entries.area: Deepwood Shrine boss room
entries.howTo: Beat the Big Green ChuChu, the Deepwood Shrine boss, by using the Gust Jar to suck the jelly from its base and then hitting it. It drops a Heart Container, and you get the Earth Element.
entries.note: The whole dungeon is explored at Minish size.

entries.name: Behind the Happy Hearth Inn
entries.area: Minish path behind the Happy Hearth Inn
entries.howTo: In the southeast house with the dog (right of the shop), flip the pot with the Cane of Pacci to get a Minish Portal and shrink. Leave the house, climb the small vine northwest of the well, go around to the back of the Happy Hearth Inn and through the gap in the flowers.

entries.name: Simon's Simulations
entries.area: Simon's Simulations (central building with a ghost on the roof)
entries.howTo: After you clear the Fortress of Winds, Simon's Simulations in the centre of town opens. Pay 10 Rupees and defeat all the enemies in the simulation; a chest with the Piece of Heart appears.

entries.name: Inside the fountain
entries.area: Fountain (Minish cave where the Power Bracelets are), northwest of the main square
entries.howTo: Go back into the Minish-sized fountain cave where you found the Power Bracelets, south of the two cats in northwest Hyrule Town. Cross the water inside and break the pots to reach the piece.
entries.note: Guides differ: Zelda Wiki and Zelda Dungeon swim across with the Flippers; Zelda's Palace glides west from the footbridge with the Roc's Cape. Either may work.

entries.name: Anju's Cucco minigame
entries.area: Anju's Cucco pen, southeast Hyrule Town
entries.howTo: Clear all 10 rounds of Anju's Cucco-catching game. In the final round one Cucco is across the river by the lumberjacks: swim over, throw it back across, then swim back. Anju gives the Piece of Heart for clearing the last round.

entries.name: The town bell
entries.area: Bell in the centre of town
entries.howTo: Stand under the bell in the centre of Hyrule Town and jump into it with the Roc's Cape. The Piece of Heart falls out.

entries.name: Figurine collector's house
entries.area: Music House, above the man left of Mama's Cafe
entries.howTo: Get the first 130 Figurines from Carlov's figurine shop by trading Mysterious Shells. Then talk, several times if needed, to the man standing left of Mama's Cafe (north of the Swiftblade dojo). He unlocks his house just above, and the piece is at the bottom of the room.

entries.name: Funday School yard
entries.area: Minish path in Funday School's schoolyard, northeast Hyrule Town
entries.howTo: Shrink using the Minish Portal (pot) inside Funday School, leave through the small hole at the bottom right and follow the Minish path in the yard to its end. Split into four on the Flashing Spots and push the big rock aside. The piece sits with four chests of Kinstones.

entries.name: Tree opened by Hurdy-Gurdy Man fusion
entries.area: Hollow tree, southeast corner
entries.howTo: Fuse Kinstones with the Hurdy-Gurdy Man in Hyrule Town; he gives you the Kinstone Bag after Deepwood Shrine. This clears the thorns from a tree in the southeast of South Hyrule Field. Go inside the tree for the piece.
entries.fusionNote: Hurdy-Gurdy Man in Hyrule Town; the game's first fusion.

entries.name: Minish cave up the river
entries.area: Minish-sized cave reached by river, southwest
entries.howTo: Dash into the tree in the far southwest corner with the Pegasus Boots to uncover a Minish Portal stump and shrink. Jump into the river to the right, swim up and right into the Minish-sized hole, then swim across the cave to the piece.

entries.name: Bombable cave, Mt. Crenel's Base
entries.area: Cave in the northwest corner of Mount Crenel's Base
entries.howTo: On Mount Crenel's Base, cross the gap between the two whirlwinds on the west side, then go all the way west and north to a dead end. Bomb the wall to open a cave with two chests, and bomb the cracked blocks inside to reach the piece.

entries.name: Bomb between the rocks by Crenel Wall
entries.area: Great Fairy cave east of the Crenel Wall
entries.howTo: After growing the vine with the Mt. Crenel Mineral Water, go up the steps to the left. Just east of the Crenel Wall and its sign, bomb between the two rocks against the wall to open a cave with fairies and the piece.

entries.name: Grayblade's dojo
entries.area: Grayblade's cave, east side of Mount Crenel
entries.howTo: Scale the east side of Mount Crenel with the Grip Ring to a cave just below the Business Scrub's cave. Inside, split in two on the Flashing Spots and press both switches to open the door; the piece is on the left.
entries.note: Splitting in two needs the White Sword with two elements (Earth and Fire).

entries.name: Beanstalk from Melari's fusion
entries.area: Beanstalk near the summit (northwest Mount Crenel)
entries.howTo: Fuse Kinstones with Melari in Melari's Mine. A Bean grows into a beanstalk at the top (far northwest) of Mount Crenel; climb it for the piece and some Rupees.

entries.name: Dig cave by the Crenel Hermit
entries.area: Diggable cave west of the Crenel Hermit's cave
entries.howTo: Climb the Crenel Wall, go west and down the ladder at the top, then dig into the sand cave on the left, next to the hermit's cave. Dig along the left side to the piece at the end.

entries.name: Bomb wall past the upturned cart
entries.area: Room south of the upside-down mine cart room
entries.howTo: In the room with the upside-down mine cart (and four traps), walk along the tracks and bomb the cracked south wall behind three pots to reach the piece. You see it earlier as Minish Link but cannot get it then.

entries.name: Gleerok
entries.area: Cave of Flames boss room
entries.howTo: Beat Gleerok, the Cave of Flames boss: shoot its back with the Cane of Pacci, climb onto its neck and slash the weak spot. It drops a Heart Container, and you get the Fire Element.

entries.name: Under the cracked block
entries.area: Cave under a bombable block near the castle approach
entries.howTo: In the northwest part of North Hyrule Field, near a sign just before the castle entrance, bomb the cracked block. Go down the ladder and the stairs, defeat the three Keese and take the piece.

entries.name: Via the hole at Lon Lon Ranch
entries.area: Ledge in Veil Falls reached from Lon Lon Ranch
entries.howTo: Use the Cane of Pacci on the hole in the far northwest/north edge of Lon Lon Ranch and jump in to pop up on the far side. Go north to Veil Falls, then east, down the steps and east again to the piece.

entries.name: Swim in from North Hyrule Field
entries.area: Ledge in the water at the Veil Falls entrance
entries.howTo: Enter Veil Falls from the northeast corner of North Hyrule Field, jump into the water and swim a short way east (towards the centre) to the ledge with the piece.

entries.name: Waterfall opened by Gale fusion
entries.area: Cave behind the waterfall near the top of Veil Falls
entries.howTo: Fuse Kinstones with Gale in the Cloud Tops to open a hole in the waterfall near the top of Veil Falls. Swim into the waterfall; the piece is just inside.

entries.name: Shoal dig cave
entries.area: Secret (dig) cave on a shoal at the bottom of Veil Falls
entries.howTo: Fuse Kinstones with the Forest Picori in the far-eastern/northeastern house of Minish Village; you have to swim to reach the house. A shoal rises in Veil Falls. Go there and dig up into the cave with the Mole Mitts to the piece.
entries.fusionNote: The Forest Picori in the far north-east house of Minish Village (swim to it), after the Wind Element. The same Picori's next fusion opens Librari's crack.

entries.name: Minish path from the dash tree
entries.area: Minish path in the ranch meadow, northwest
entries.howTo: Dash into the tree in the northwest of the ranch's field with the Pegasus Boots to knock its leaves off and reveal a Minish Portal stump. Shrink, head right until you can go up into the Minish-scale area, then go all the way north to the piece.

entries.name: Exit of the Lake Hylia dig cave
entries.area: Ledge at Lon Lon Ranch where the north Lake Hylia cave comes out
entries.howTo: Hop across the islands to the north shore of Lake Hylia with the Roc's Cape and dig into the cave there. Take the left paths, digging through, until you come out at Lon Lon Ranch; the piece is just to your left.

entries.name: Swiftblade I's dojo
entries.area: Swiftblade I's dojo under the grave, far west of Castor Wilds
entries.howTo: Use the Pegasus Boots to cross to the far-west land of Castor Wilds, just above the three statues. Push the gravestone up and go down into Swiftblade I's dojo; the piece is at the bottom left of the room. You can take it even before he will train you.

entries.name: Northeast swamp cave
entries.area: Cave on the small island, far northeast
entries.howTo: Swim past the Eyegore to the small island in the far northeast corner of Castor Wilds and enter the cave. Push the blocks in the right order (top-right block in, third block from top in, then the one between them up) to reach the piece.

entries.name: Minish cave via the lily
entries.area: Minish-sized cave, far southeast of Castor Wilds
entries.howTo: After the fusion that makes a lily appear in Castor Wilds, shrink at the Minish Portal stump in the wilds, ride the new lily, and make your way as Minish Link to the far southeast. Swim to the far right to a small Minish cave and work through the blocks and enemies to the piece.
entries.fusionNote: One of the lily fusions: a Forest Picori in Minish Village or Zill in Hyrule Town.
entries.note: Guides name different fusion partners for the lily; any of the lily fusions in Castor Wilds may open the way.

entries.name: Grimblade's dojo
entries.area: Hidden cave under the bushes, southeast corner of the garden
entries.howTo: Cut the bushes in the southeast corner of Hyrule Castle Garden to find a hidden ladder. Climb down and go up through the doorway into Grimblade's dojo; the piece is in the southwest of the room. You don't need the Flame Lantern for the piece, only for his training.

entries.name: Drained northeast pool
entries.area: Northeast pool / fountain of the garden
entries.howTo: A Kinstone fusion drains the pond in the northeast of Hyrule Castle Garden. Go down the steps where the water was to take the piece.
entries.fusionNote: A random fusion: keep fusing with people in Hyrule Town until it comes up (Zelda Universe says the Hurdy-Gurdy Man's second).

entries.name: Cave below the middle vine
entries.area: Minish cave, west of the Fortress of Winds entrance
entries.howTo: Shrink at the tree stump beside the Fortress of Winds entrance and head west. Climb down a vine, then another on the far left; where three vines hang, take the middle one to a small cave. Follow its winding path to the piece.

entries.name: Minish drop in the east wing
entries.area: East section of the dungeon, first floor
entries.howTo: From the first room, go through the door at the far right (east) and climb to the top. Shrink at the Minish Portal, drop down the two holes back to the first floor, then go right through the small passage and return to normal size to take the piece.

entries.name: Mazaal
entries.area: Fortress of Winds boss room
entries.howTo: Beat Mazaal, the Fortress of Winds boss: shoot the weak points on its hands with arrows, then slash them. When the head drops, shrink at a Minish Portal in the room's top corners and go in through its mouth to hit the one weak pillar; in later rounds dig through the dirt inside with the Mole Mitts. It drops a Heart Container.

entries.name: Beanstalk from the Eastern Hills Minish
entries.area: Beanstalk, southwest Eastern Hills
entries.howTo: After you have the Ocarina of Wind, shrink and enter the Minish house in the far southwest of the Eastern Hills, then fuse Kinstones with the Minish there. A beanstalk grows just north. Return to normal size and climb it for the piece, plus Rupees and Mysterious Shells.
entries.fusionNote: The Forest Picori in the Minish house in the far south-west of the Eastern Hills, after you have the Ocarina of Wind.

entries.name: Tree opened by the Wind Crest Minish
entries.area: Hollow tree in the centre of Western Wood
entries.howTo: Warp to the Wind Crest at Lake Hylia with the Ocarina of Wind, shrink, and fuse Kinstones with the Forest Picori in the house there. A tree in the centre of Western Wood opens; go inside for the piece.
entries.fusionNote: The Forest Picori in the Minish house by the Wind Crest at Lake Hylia.

entries.name: Dive in the pond by Stockwell's House
entries.area: Small pond west of Stockwell's House, north side of the lake
entries.howTo: Next to the house on the north side of Lake Hylia (Stockwell's House, reached through Talon's house at Lon Lon Ranch) is a small pond on its left. Dive in the middle of it for the piece.

entries.name: Southern ledge
entries.area: Small ledge in the south of the lake, west of Hagen's Cabin
entries.howTo: Swim to the southern part of Lake Hylia; the piece sits on a small ledge just west of Mayor Hagen's cabin.

entries.name: Waveblade's dojo
entries.area: Waveblade's tree, south of the Temple of Droplets / southwest shore
entries.howTo: Swim to Waveblade's dojo inside a tree on the southwest shore of the lake, south of the Temple of Droplets. The piece is on the left of his training room.

entries.name: Big Octorok
entries.area: Temple of Droplets boss room
entries.howTo: Beat the Big Octorok, the Temple of Droplets boss, fought at Minish size: deflect the rocks it spits with your shield, and when it freezes itself, run behind it and light the flower on its back with the Flame Lantern. Repeat a few times. It drops a Heart Container, and you get the Water Element.
entries.note: The Temple of Droplets has no Piece of Heart, so its boss is listed under Lake Hylia.

entries.name: Island hop north of the temple
entries.area: Small platform northeast of the Temple of Droplets
entries.howTo: Use the Roc's Cape to hop across the small islands in the northern part of the lake (northeast of the Temple of Droplets, east of the Tingle sibling David Jr.) to the platform with the piece.

entries.name: Beanstalk via the north shore dig cave
entries.area: Beanstalk reached through the north-shore dig cave
entries.howTo: Fuse with the Minish in the lone hole on the far east side of Lake Hylia to plant a beanstalk. Hop the islands to the north shore with the Roc's Cape, dig into the cave with the Mole Mitts and take the right-hand path. Climb the ladders out to the beanstalk and climb it for the piece and two chests.
entries.fusionNote: The Forest Picori in the lone hole on the far east side of Lake Hylia.

entries.name: Librari's hideaway
entries.area: Librari's Minish house on the island in the centre of Lake Hylia
entries.howTo: After the Four Sword is made and Hyrule Castle turns dark, Librari leaves the library. Fuse Kinstones with the Forest Picori in the far-eastern/northeastern house of Minish Village to open a crack by the Wind Crest at Lake Hylia. Warp there, shrink, drop into the crack and cross the spike-roller tunnel, using the Gust Jar to clear dust off the safe holes. Talk to Librari in his house for a full Heart Container.
entries.fusionNote: The Forest Picori in the far north-east house of Minish Village, after the Wind Element: the fusion after the one that raises the Veil Falls shoal.
entries.note: The sixth Heart Container: the only one that isn't a boss's.

entries.name: Northwest grave in the graveyard
entries.area: Grave under the northwest tombstone, Royal Valley graveyard
entries.howTo: In the Royal Valley graveyard, push the northwest tombstone up and go down into the grave. Split into three on the Flashing Spots and push the large block aside to reach the piece.

entries.name: 4F northwest, over the gap
entries.area: Fourth floor, northwest corner of the main room
entries.howTo: On the fourth floor of the Palace of Winds main room, go to the northwest corner and push the row of blocks so they fall to the floor below. Jump the gap with the Roc's Cape and go north through the door and up the long hallway; you come back outside next to the piece.

entries.name: Gyorg Pair
entries.area: Palace of Winds boss arena (Cloud Tops)
entries.howTo: Beat the Gyorg Pair, the Palace of Winds boss, in mid-air: jump between the two with the Roc's Cape and split with the White Sword to hit all of the female's eyes at once. They drop a Heart Container, and you get the Wind Element.
